FEAT-2-S131.title: Implement Confidence Scoring and Ranking Normalization
FEAT-2-S131.description: Add deterministic scoring logic to normalize outputs from regex and vector pipelines into a unified confidence score, including tie-breaking, thresholding, and top-N selection for NUCC codes.

FEAT-2-S132.title: Add Caching for Repeated Specialty Queries
FEAT-2-S132.description: Implement lightweight caching for repeated or semantically similar specialty queries to reduce redundant vector calls and improve latency, leveraging existing embedding/query patterns.

FEAT-2-S133.title: Error Handling and Fallback Behavior for Specialty Mapping
FEAT-2-S133.description: Implement robust error handling for cases where vector search, query expansion, or taxonomy lookup fails, ensuring graceful fallback to regex-only results or empty structured responses.

FEAT-2-S134.title: Instrumentation and Debug Logging for Specialty Identification
FEAT-2-S134.description: Add structured debug logging for specialty identification pipeline stages (regex hits, vector matches, expansion terms, final NUCC selection) to support observability and QA analysis.
